title: Operator norm of an n-covector is at most P^n times a bound on its standard-basis values
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n and C ≥ 0 such that |α(e_{j(0)}, …, e_{j(n−1)})| ≤ C for every j : Fin n → Fin P, where e = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ is the standard orthonormal basis of ℝ^P. Then the operator norm of α satisfies ‖α‖ ≤ P^n·C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → (∀ j : Fin n → Fin P, |α (fun k => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (j k))| ≤ C) → ‖α‖ ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ n * C
